name: 4B oracle reference run
command: ssh -o BatchMode=yes luigi@raspberrypi.tailf63b31.ts.net 'cd ~ && /home/luigi/pulsar-rpi/v/bin/python -u q2_0_ref.py bonsai4b_q2_0.bin 785,6722,315,9625,374 3 > /tmp/oracle4b.log 2>&1; echo "EXIT=$?"; head -1 /tmp/oracle4b.log; echo "--- DX L35 p4 ---"; grep -A1 "^DX L35 p4" /tmp/oracle4b.log; tail -2 /tmp/oracle4b.log; echo "--- oracle size ---"; wc -l /tmp/oracle4b.log'
description: Run the Qwen3/Q2_0 fp32 oracle on the 4B blob (5 positions x 36 layers) to produce the asm verification reference
